note_on_tag: The 11 assets were built from build_source 4739d29 (headSha of every build/gate run). The published tag v1.1.3 will point at a release-metadata commit C' whose only difference from 4739d29 is this file plus owner-approval-v1.1.3.json; neither JSON is a build input, so the compilable code is identical. The binaries were NOT built from C'.

previous_incorrect_tag.reason: tag created too early (before the fair-launch/IBD/startup-guard/sidecar-signing/receive-modal commits and before the R English-only cleanup); it was never published, latest.json never offered it, no updater push happened. Corrected to the real 1.1.3 build source.

gates_note: All 8 gates ran on build_source 4739d29. build-windows/linux/macos, verify-candidate, test-installer-scenarios, e2e and tests(rust+guards, incl. English-only which now passes) headSha=4739d29. verify-update ran from_version=1.1.1 to_version=1.1.3 against the R draft assets (an earlier run used the wrong default inputs 1.0.8/1.0.9 and was discarded, not counted as PASS). A separate verify-update from 1.1.2 is also being run for the upgrade matrix.

signatures_verified.method: ed25519 over blake2b-512, checked against the updater pubkey embedded in tauri.conf.json

hashes_verified: the 11 asset SHA-256 were taken from GitHub asset digests; the three updater artifacts were downloaded and their SHA-256 + minisign signatures recomputed and verified locally.
